AESO, Large Load Integration Phase 2A — Proposed BYOG Process (26 Jun 2026, proposal, not final). Applies to transmission-connected loads asking for 75 MW or more of demand transmission service (DTS), site-aggregated; excludes loads under 75 MW, distribution-connected load and storage. First intake gas-fired generation only, "net new"; tethering ratio: generator output at 25 °C, 40% humidity equals DTS contract capacity. Data centres must show municipal zoning or area-structure-plan approval and accept the data-centre connection requirements. DTS commitment fee $15k/MW (refundable). Bridging before the generator runs: at most 20/30/40% of the DTS request by generator milestone, 1,600 MW across all intakes, up to 3 years; bridging load is fully interruptible, reduced before all other non-firm load to avoid a shortfall, curtailment scheme TBD (pro rata, rotation or combination); suspended for failing to curtail — https://aesoengage.aeso.ca/pre-engagement-phase-ii-large-load-integration

PDF 16 Oct 2026). s. 1: data centre includes hosting/cloud, digital asset mining, AI/ML, content delivery. s. 2: "large data centre" = maximum demand directly from the transmission system of 75 MW or more, or a lower threshold the AESO sets for reliability. s. 3: AESO may aggregate integrated data centres on the same or adjacent parcels with the same owner or affiliate. s. 5: a large data centre may be "tethered" to new or added generating units or energy storage able to supply at least its maximum demand, reliably and predictably (the Regulation does not limit the fuel; AESO's first intake does). s. 6: tethered requests processed first. s. 7: AESO may require site control, municipal zoning approvals, financing, permits or water licences. s. 8: no service above the tethered supply. s. 9: bridged service before the supply runs only once the plant is approved by the AUC, max 3 years, AESO may cap each and all bridged loads and suspend for unmet criteria. s. 10: inadequate supply — bridged data centres reduced before all other market participants; mandatory load shed — large data centres reduced before all others. s. 12: review by 31 May 2030, expires 31 May 2035 — https://open.alberta.ca/publications/2026_117
